items.title: Registry-backed ReleaseBinding
items.note: The declarative agent architecture is a project rather than a production path until this lands: GitOps carries shadow ReleaseBindingIntent with promotable:false, and the resolver refuses to proceed on bindingSource: registry.

items.title: Investigator resolver off legacy
reasons: probe resolver-mode-in-gitops: 1 file(s) under mctlhq/mctl-gitops/platform-gitops/argo-workflows/cluster-templates matching /ISSUE_INVESTIGATOR_RESOLVER_MODE\s*\n\s*value:\s*"?declarative"?/ = 0, expected == 1
items.note: Activation is blocked on mctl-gitops#950 per the code comment, and on agent-platform.registry for the binding source. Expected to be failing until both land — this item exists so that the day it flips is observed rather than noticed.

items.title: Agent execution identity
items.note: Owns execution identity; .github#55 observability consumes it. The two referenced each other as blockers until 2026-09-11, when the edge was made one-directional.

items.title: Policy, approval and evidence checkpoints
items.note: #198 is cited by .github#42 as the approval primitive but is not implemented; the durable wait that does exist is #150 / PR #212, and WAITING_FOR_APPROVAL appears nowhere in code.

items.title: ContextSnapshot contract
items.note: Merged as f9efb074 on 2026-09-11 21:09Z. The contract is accepted; what the review could not settle went to mctl-agents#347, chiefly whether `truncated` means "the budget was exhausted" or "something did not make it in" -- today an honest snapshot that drops an oversized candidate fails its own validation unless it claims a truncation that did not happen.

items.title: Durable human input / WAITING_FOR_INPUT
items.note: Blocked by mctl-api#227 (done) and mctl-agents#264 (in review).

items.title: At least one service emitting spans
reasons: probe services-opted-into-otel: 27 file(s) under mctlhq/mctl-gitops/platform-gitops/services matching /(?ms)^otel:\s*\n(?:\s+.*\n)*?\s+enabled:\s*true/ = 0, expected >= 1
items.note: The transport shipped with #902, but otel.enabled is false everywhere and otelCollector.backendEndpoint is empty, so end-to-end traces are still zero. This item is the observability critical path now, not the collector.

items.title: Zone roots on shared remote state
items.note: Only the `account` root is on the shared R2 backend. Until the three zone roots follow, Git is the source of truth for one root out of four.

items.title: Prove the properties of the live edge
items.note: Phase 1 is live with three upstreams behind mcp.mctl.ai. The next step is measurement of what exists, not more servers.

items.title: Identity attributes and profile
items.note: Approved on the current head, every check green, blocked on unresolved review conversations. Also carries steward:escalated, which is terminal for pr-steward: that label has to be cleared by a human before the lifecycle resumes, so silence here needs a person rather than time.

items.title: Scoped Telegram lookup account
items.note: Waiting on a human: the account must be registered against a free number and its numeric id handed over before the allowlist entry and mctl-gitops#1182 can be applied. No amount of time moves this.

items.title: Steward-owned repos have a lifecycle path
Android edge feasibility
items.note: Deliberately unstaffed R&D. Needs a device in hand and an ADR on where the work lives; no child issue exists and none should be invented.
